title: Item lookup returns any item by id
description: The items handler returns the stored item for any id the caller sends.
claimed_root_cause: The handler calls the store with the request id and never compares the item owner with the caller.

trace.description: Reads the id from the query string.
Looks the item up by id alone.
Returns the item body to the caller.

evidence.description: No owner comparison between lookup and response.

blockers: Whether the gateway in front of the service enforces item ownership is not in the repository.

validation_plan.deployment: Ask the service owner to show the gateway policy for the items route.
